gen-righteous-gf-narnoor: Short ascenders sit above big bowls here, so the text feels compact and level-headed. Narnoor keeps to that job while Righteous, bent from thin rod-like strokes, earns its place big and short.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-display: Punchy rod-bent capitals: Righteous fills each line with bowls that never swell, while Noto Sans Display below stands tall through the middle. Sturdy shapes up top, approachable ease underneath; that is its pull.
gen-righteous-gf-play: Play has barely any height gap between its capitals and lowercase. Give Righteous, drawn with one fixed nib, the larger size and let Play's arches, which thin slightly leaving the stem, sit smaller beneath.
gen-righteous-gf-port-lligat-sans: Modern and compact, Port Lligat Sans packs its letters tight. Righteous brings flat, stencil-cut strokes of single weight up top, and the two settle into a page with one loud voice and one quiet one.
gen-righteous-gf-ramabhadra: Loud, rounded and rod-drawn: that is Righteous. Ramabhadra takes over with a prominent x-height, while Righteous gives its t a crossbar matching the stem in weight, so the body text stays quietly clean.
gen-righteous-gf-rambla: Rambla keeps its small letters standing almost as tall as capitals. Rambla then sits neatly beside Righteous, whose lines carry no modulation whatsoever, so the whole page stays clean.
gen-righteous-gf-recursive: Rounded, rod-bent swagger from Righteous, with bowls that fill the line. Recursive keeps a tall mean line and a thickness that never shifts direction, so extended text reads in a friendly, modern way.
gen-righteous-gf-saira-semi-condensed: Righteous looks like thin steel rod bent into letters. Saira Semi Condensed sits beneath it, looking magnified without changing size, its weight unvarying from word to word and its manner modern.
gen-righteous-gf-secular-one: Fun-loving Righteous fills the line with bowls bent from thin steel rod. And Secular One, whose big midsection swallows the line, looks best at a modest size beside it.
gen-righteous-gf-smooch-sans: Modern and tight: Smooch Sans packs its line so closely the gaps nearly vanish, with a high midline and an open s. Righteous counters with uninterrupted line widths on every letter.
